summary_ja: 長文脈・agent推論向けの新規storage tierとしてNVIDIA CMXを追加しました。BlueField-4、NVMe、DOCA Memos、Spectrum-X、DynamoによるKV cache共有を、従来filesystem・archiveとは異なる用途として整理し、2026年下期のBlueField-4予定と個別製品未確認を区別しました。最大5倍の性能・電力効率は比較条件未公開のvendor claimとして扱います。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds NVIDIA CMX as a new storage tier for long-context and agentic inference. It distinguishes BlueField-4, NVMe, DOCA Memos, Spectrum-X, and Dynamo-based KV-cache sharing from conventional file systems and archives, and separates planned second-half-2026 BlueField-4 availability from unverified individual products. Up-to-5x performance and power efficiency are treated as vendor claims without public matched conditions. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 長文脈推論向けcontext memory storage
sections.summary_ja: GPU HBMと汎用共有storageの間にKV cache専用のEthernet接続flash tierを置くCMXを、data path、software、security、提供時期、未検証性能に分けて整理します。
sections.summary_en: Organize CMX, an Ethernet-attached flash tier for KV cache between GPU HBM and general shared storage, by data path, software, security, product timing, and unverified performance.

items.name_ja: CMXはKV cacheをpod単位で共有する専用storage tier
items.name_en: CMX is a dedicated pod-wide storage tier for shared KV cache
items.timing_ja: BlueField-4は2026年下期提供予定、個別CMX製品日は未確認
items.timing_en: BlueField-4 planned for the second half of 2026; individual CMX product dates unverified
items.statement_ja: NVIDIA CMXは、GPU memoryを補完するpod単位のcontext tierとして、ephemeralなKV cacheをEthernet接続flashへ保持・共有する構成です。BlueField-4がNVMe SSD、storage service、整合性検査、暗号化を処理し、DOCA Memosがkey-value API、cache routing、再利用を提供します。Spectrum-Xのlossless RoCE/RDMAで接続し、DynamoがKV cacheの所在を考慮してrequestを配置します。これはPOSIX共有filesystemやarchiveの代替ではなく、長文脈推論の再計算とGPU stallを減らす専用層です。
items.statement_en: NVIDIA CMX is a pod-wide context tier that complements GPU memory by retaining and sharing ephemeral KV cache on Ethernet-attached flash. BlueField-4 manages NVMe SSDs, storage services, integrity checks, and encryption; DOCA Memos exposes key-value APIs, cache routing, and reuse. Spectrum-X supplies lossless RoCE and RDMA, while Dynamo places requests with awareness of KV-cache location. It is not a replacement for POSIX shared file systems or archives, but a specialized tier intended to reduce recomputation and GPU stalls in long-context inference.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: AI for Science agent基盤のstorage設計では、dataset・checkpoint・archiveに加え、KV cacheの容量、再利用率、TTL、tenant隔離、失敗時再計算を独立したtierとして見積もる必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: AI-for-Science agent storage design should size KV-cache capacity, reuse, TTL, tenant isolation, and failure recomputation as a separate tier in addition to datasets, checkpoints, and archives.
adoption_conditions_ja: CMX対応製品ごとに一般提供日、flash容量、帯域、metadata規模、耐障害性、価格を確認する。
KV cacheの暗号化、tenant隔離、消去、TTL、model/version誤対応防止を検証する。
cache hit率を固定し、TTFT、ITL、TPS、電力、再計算量を従来storage・local NVMe・HBMと比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Confirm general availability, flash capacity, bandwidth, metadata scale, fault tolerance, and price for each CMX product.
Validate encryption, tenant isolation, deletion, TTL, and prevention of model or version mismatches for KV cache.
Hold cache hit rate constant and compare TTFT, ITL, TPS, power, and recomputation against conventional storage, local NVMe, and HBM.

items.name_ja: 最大5倍のthroughput・電力効率は比較条件未公開のvendor claim
items.name_en: Up-to-5x throughput and power efficiency remain vendor claims without public matched conditions
items.timing_ja: 2026年1月発表、第三者検証未確認
items.statement_ja: NVIDIAは従来storage比で最大5倍のtokens/sと最大5倍の電力効率を公表し、BlueField-4を利用するstorage partnerとしてDDN、Dell、HPE、Hitachi Vantara、IBM、VAST Data、WEKA等を列挙しています。ただし、公表ページからはbaseline storage、model、context長、cache hit率、GPU数、容量、network、測定区間、第三者再現結果を確認できません。partner列挙も各社製品の一般提供、同一機能、相互運用認証を意味しません。
items.statement_en: NVIDIA reports up to 5x tokens per second and up to 5x power efficiency over traditional storage and lists DDN, Dell, HPE, Hitachi Vantara, IBM, VAST Data, WEKA, and others as storage partners building with BlueField-4. The public pages do not identify the baseline storage, model, context length, cache-hit rate, GPU count, capacity, network, timed region, or independent reproduction. Partner listings also do not establish general availability, identical functionality, or interoperability certification for each product.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 調達比較ではpartner数や最大倍率を採点せず、同一model・context・SLA・電力境界での測定と、既存filesystem/backupとの統合費用を評価します。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Procurement should not score partner count or maximum multipliers; it should measure matched models, contexts, SLAs, and power boundaries and account for integration with existing file systems and backup.
adoption_conditions_ja: vendor benchmarkの完全なmethodologyと再現可能なartifactを取得する。
partner別の製品名、機能、提供地域、保守、support matrixを確認する。
cache障害、network partition、metadata loss、software upgrade時の復旧を試験する。
adoption_conditions_en: Obtain complete vendor benchmark methodology and reproducible artifacts.
Confirm product names, functions, regions, maintenance, and support matrices for each partner.
Test recovery from cache failure, network partition, metadata loss, and software upgrades.
